'''''Pallavicinia''''' is a globally distributed genus in the [[Marchantiophyta|liverwort]] [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Pallaviciniaceae]]. Thallus is simple and contains a strong hair-like midrib. Thallus area except midrib made out of one layer of cells. Thallus is dark green in color and it is very small ({{cvt|3-6|cm}} in long and 4-5 mm broad). Margins are entirely or irregularly lobed. Most species are distributed in tropical, subtropical or temperate regions. It grows in shady and moist environments, such as moist soil-covered rocks and banks of fresh water streams. Female thallus lobes have cup-shaped fringed receptacles.
